chapters.title: Chapter 1646: Vein of Strength - 1
paragraphs: Seeing every weapon aimed directly at him while more than a dozen killing intents locked onto his body at the same time, Max remained completely calm as though the situation before him carried no threat whatsoever, and not even the slightest trace of nervousness appeared on his face despite the overwhelming hostility surrounding him from every direction.
Instead, a smile slowly appeared across his face.

However, this was not the calm and composed smile that people usually associated with him. This smile carried an unmistakable sense of excitement, almost as though he had finally found something worthy of entertaining him after a long period of boredom.
There was anticipation within his eyes, a dangerous eagerness that only intensified the more greed and confidence he sensed from the disciples standing below him.

Those participants genuinely believed that because Max’s cultivation realm was lower than theirs, they could suppress him through sheer numbers alone, and the certainty within their expressions made the battle spirit inside Max rise even further.
In their eyes, this trial favored them completely.
They believed Max was weak.
They believed his previous performances had merely been luck or temporary brilliance that could never overcome the advantage of superior cultivation.
And Max found that line of thinking amusing beyond words.

The seven-colored lightning surrounding his body crackled violently as he slowly descended from the sky with complete composure, stopping only a few meters above the ground while his gaze calmly swept across every participant gathered around him.
The faint smile on his face gradually widened as though he had already seen the outcome of the battle long before it even began.
"So all of you decided to target me first?" Max asked lightly, his tone carrying neither anger nor fear, but instead sounding almost entertained by the situation.
The disciple wielding the massive battle axe immediately let out a cold sneer as he stepped forward slightly and pointed the heavy weapon toward Max.
"You should feel honored," he mocked arrogantly. "Not everyone gets treated like such a valuable target during the trial."
Another participant standing nearby laughed harshly while gripping his weapon tighter.
"You only have yourself to blame for standing out too much during the previous trials," he said coldly. "Now everyone wants your points."
The disciple holding the black saber slowly raised his weapon as a sharp glint flashed through his eyes.
"You should surrender your points and eliminate yourself peacefully," he said in a calm but threatening voice. "Otherwise, what happens next is going to become extremely painful for you."
Hearing those words, Max merely chuckled softly under his breath as though he had just heard something genuinely funny.
Then he spoke a single word.
"Come."
The instant that word left his mouth, the entire atmosphere changed completely.
Boom!

A terrifying pressure erupted violently from Max’s body like a sleeping monster finally awakening. The ground beneath him exploded apart instantly as massive cracks spread across the clearing at an astonishing speed, tearing through the earth while nearby trees trembled fiercely under the force of the pressure wave.
Countless leaves were blown away into the sky as the sheer power radiating from Max distorted the surrounding air itself.
The expressions of the disciples surrounding him changed immediately.
"What is this pressure?!" one participant shouted in shock as his face paled.
"This aura..." another disciple muttered while instinctively stepping backward.
Before anyone could react any further, Max slowly clenched his fist.
At that exact moment, the Third Divine Vein within the Seven Divine Veins opened completely inside his body.
Vein of Strength.
Boom!!!

An overwhelming surge of power exploded from within Max like a volcanic eruption that had been suppressed for far too long. The blood flowing through his body roared violently as unimaginable physical strength flooded every muscle, every bone, and every cell with terrifying force.
Veins glowing faintly beneath his skin pulsed with immense energy while the surrounding space distorted under the pressure radiating from him.
This was the first time since opening the Third Divine Vein that Max had fully unleashed the Vein of Strength during an actual battle.
And the effect was horrifying.

The surrounding disciples felt as though an invisible mountain had descended directly onto their shoulders, causing several participants to stagger backward instinctively as fear began to appear within their eyes.
"This..." the black saber disciple muttered in disbelief while staring at Max with widened eyes.
"How can a ninth level Law Awakening cultivator release this kind of power?!"

Max slowly raised his head, and at that moment, even without using concepts, laws, or combat techniques, the raw physical might erupting from his body alone already felt overwhelmingly oppressive to everyone present.
It was pure strength.
Absolute strength.

The Vein of Strength amplified Max’s physical power to such an absurd level that even the slightest movement of his body caused the surrounding air to tremble faintly, as though space itself struggled to endure the monstrous force flowing within him.
The woman wielding twin daggers felt her heartbeat accelerate uncontrollably as danger instincts screamed within her mind.
"This pressure... it’s dangerous!" she said with visible fear in her voice.
The battle axe wielder gritted his teeth as sweat slowly formed across his forehead.
"No," he said forcefully while trying to steady himself. "He’s bluffing. There’s no way his real strength can match this aura."
Yet even as he spoke those words, uncertainty had already appeared deep within his eyes.

Max lowered his gaze toward his own hand slowly while feeling the immense power coursing throughout his body, and the sensation almost felt intoxicating. Endless strength overflowed from deep within him with such overwhelming intensity that it genuinely felt as though he could shatter mountains apart with his bare fists alone.
Then suddenly—
Max disappeared.
Boom!
The ground where he had been standing exploded apart instantly from the force of his movement alone.
Several disciples’ pupils contracted violently.
"So fast!"
Before anyone could properly react, Max had already appeared directly in front of the battle axe wielder.
The disciple’s expression changed drastically as instinctive fear exploded within his mind. He roared loudly while raising his battle axe and pouring every ounce of his power into defense.
However, Max simply threw a punch forward.
He did not use sword intent.
He did not use lightning.
He did not use concepts, laws, or martial techniques.
It was merely a single punch empowered by the Vein of Strength.
The moment that punch collided against the massive axe—
Boom!!!

A deafening explosion erupted across the clearing as the enormous battle axe shattered apart instantly under the terrifying force of Max’s strike. The disciple behind it spat blood violently while his defenses were crushed completely, and his body flew backward like a broken ragdoll before smashing through dozens of giant trees one after another.
The entire clearing fell silent.
Everyone stared at the scene in horror.
One punch.
Only one punch.
And a peak Law Refinement Realm participant had been completely overwhelmed without any ability to resist.
Before the others could even recover from their shock, Max moved again.
His figure flashed across the battlefield like a phantom moving faster than their eyes could follow.
Boom!
A spear shattered into countless fragments.
Boom!
A massive hammer exploded apart instantly.
Boom!
Another participant was blasted high into the air while coughing blood uncontrollably.
Everywhere Max passed, destruction followed behind him.
The truly terrifying part was that he still had not used a single concept or combat technique throughout the battle.
He relied purely on the raw physical strength granted by the Vein of Strength.
And that strength alone was already enough to completely dominate peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses as though they were powerless before him.

sentences.text: Seeing every weapon aimed directly at him while more than a dozen killing intents locked onto his body at the same time, Max remained completely calm as though the situation before him carried no threat whatsoever, and not even the slightest trace of nervousness appeared on his face despite the overwhelming hostility surrounding him from every direction.
Instead, a smile slowly appeared across his face.
However, this was not the calm and composed smile that people usually associated with him.
This smile carried an unmistakable sense of excitement, almost as though he had finally found something worthy of entertaining him after a long period of boredom.
There was anticipation within his eyes, a dangerous eagerness that only intensified the more greed and confidence he sensed from the disciples standing below him.

Those participants genuinely believed that because Max’s cultivation realm was lower than theirs, they could suppress him through sheer numbers alone, and the certainty within their expressions made the battle spirit inside Max rise even further.
In their eyes, this trial favored them completely.
They believed Max was weak.
They believed his previous performances had merely been luck or temporary brilliance that could never overcome the advantage of superior cultivation.
And Max found that line of thinking amusing beyond words.

The seven-colored lightning surrounding his body crackled violently as he slowly descended from the sky with complete composure, stopping only a few meters above the ground while his gaze calmly swept across every participant gathered around him.
The faint smile on his face gradually widened as though he had already seen the outcome of the battle long before it even began.
"So all of you decided to target me first?" Max asked lightly, his tone carrying neither anger nor fear, but instead sounding almost entertained by the situation.
The disciple wielding the massive battle axe immediately let out a cold sneer as he stepped forward slightly and pointed the heavy weapon toward Max.
"You should feel honored," he mocked arrogantly.
"Not everyone gets treated like such a valuable target during the trial."
Another participant standing nearby laughed harshly while gripping his weapon tighter.
"You only have yourself to blame for standing out too much during the previous trials," he said coldly.
"Now everyone wants your points."
The disciple holding the black saber slowly raised his weapon as a sharp glint flashed through his eyes.
"You should surrender your points and eliminate yourself peacefully," he said in a calm but threatening voice.
"Otherwise, what happens next is going to become extremely painful for you."
Hearing those words, Max merely chuckled softly under his breath as though he had just heard something genuinely funny.
Then he spoke a single word.
"Come."
The instant that word left his mouth, the entire atmosphere changed completely.
Boom!
A terrifying pressure erupted violently from Max’s body like a sleeping monster finally awakening.

The ground beneath him exploded apart instantly as massive cracks spread across the clearing at an astonishing speed, tearing through the earth while nearby trees trembled fiercely under the force of the pressure wave.
Countless leaves were blown away into the sky as the sheer power radiating from Max distorted the surrounding air itself.
The expressions of the disciples surrounding him changed immediately.
"What is this pressure?!" one participant shouted in shock as his face paled.
"This aura..." another disciple muttered while instinctively stepping backward.
Before anyone could react any further, Max slowly clenched his fist.
At that exact moment, the Third Divine Vein within the Seven Divine Veins opened completely inside his body.
Vein of Strength.
Boom!!!
An overwhelming surge of power exploded from within Max like a volcanic eruption that had been suppressed for far too long.
The blood flowing through his body roared violently as unimaginable physical strength flooded every muscle, every bone, and every cell with terrifying force.
Veins glowing faintly beneath his skin pulsed with immense energy while the surrounding space distorted under the pressure radiating from him.
This was the first time since opening the Third Divine Vein that Max had fully unleashed the Vein of Strength during an actual battle.
And the effect was horrifying.

The surrounding disciples felt as though an invisible mountain had descended directly onto their shoulders, causing several participants to stagger backward instinctively as fear began to appear within their eyes.
"This..." the black saber disciple muttered in disbelief while staring at Max with widened eyes.
"How can a ninth level Law Awakening cultivator release this kind of power?!"

Max slowly raised his head, and at that moment, even without using concepts, laws, or combat techniques, the raw physical might erupting from his body alone already felt overwhelmingly oppressive to everyone present.
It was pure strength.
Absolute strength.

The Vein of Strength amplified Max’s physical power to such an absurd level that even the slightest movement of his body caused the surrounding air to tremble faintly, as though space itself struggled to endure the monstrous force flowing within him.
The woman wielding twin daggers felt her heartbeat accelerate uncontrollably as danger instincts screamed within her mind.
"This pressure... it’s dangerous!" she said with visible fear in her voice.
The battle axe wielder gritted his teeth as sweat slowly formed across his forehead.
"No," he said forcefully while trying to steady himself.
"He’s bluffing.
There’s no way his real strength can match this aura."
Yet even as he spoke those words, uncertainty had already appeared deep within his eyes.
Max lowered his gaze toward his own hand slowly while feeling the immense power coursing throughout his body, and the sensation almost felt intoxicating.
Endless strength overflowed from deep within him with such overwhelming intensity that it genuinely felt as though he could shatter mountains apart with his bare fists alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 1647: Vein of Strength - 2
paragraphs: Panic rapidly spread throughout the clearing.
"This monster..."
"How is this even possible?!"
"He’s not even using concepts!"
The expressions of the disciples who had mocked Max only moments earlier were now filled entirely with fear and disbelief as the reality before them shattered everything they thought they understood.
Only now did they finally realize something terrifying.
They had assumed cultivation level was Max’s greatest weakness.
But the truth was far more horrifying.
Even without relying on cultivation, Max was already strong enough to crush every single one of them.

The entire clearing had already descended into complete chaos as shattered trees littered the battlefield in every direction while enormous craters spread across the ground from the terrifying force behind Max’s attacks.

The once dense forest had been devastated beyond recognition, with broken trunks, collapsed earth, and countless fragments of stone scattered everywhere. Several disciples lay sprawled across the ruined battlefield while blood continuously dripped from their mouths, and the confidence they once possessed when surrounding Max earlier had now completely disappeared, replaced entirely by fear and disbelief.
Meanwhile, Max himself stood calmly in the center of the destruction as though the devastation around him had nothing to do with him at all.
Seven-colored lightning crackled faintly around his body while violent currents of power continued surging through every part of him without slowing in the slightest.
The Third Divine Vein remained fully active.
Vein of Strength.

Max slowly clenched his fist as he carefully felt the terrifying physical power coursing through his body like an endless torrent. Every muscle within him overflowed with monstrous force while every movement carried enough weight to distort the surrounding air faintly.

Even now, despite the destruction he had already caused, Max could clearly feel that he was still subconsciously restraining himself to some extent because the overwhelming power flooding his body had already surpassed the level these participants could possibly endure.
"I’m already holding back..." Max thought quietly while his gaze swept across the terrified disciples surrounding him.
His eyes slowly moved from one participant to another as he observed the fear spreading across their faces.
"And yet I can still crush peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses this easily."
The realization caused even Max himself to feel slightly surprised deep inside.

These participants were not weak cultivators by any means. Every single person gathered here was considered a genius within their respective third-rate forces, individuals who normally stood above ordinary cultivators and possessed enough talent to dominate those below them.
Under normal circumstances, a peak Law Refinement Realm cultivator should have been more than capable of suppressing a ninth-level Law Awakening Realm cultivator with overwhelming ease.
Yet before the Vein of Strength—
They appeared utterly powerless.
A faint smile slowly formed on Max’s face as he continued feeling the terrifying power surging throughout his body.
"If this is the result while I’m restraining myself..."
The light within his eyes gradually sharpened.
"Then what happens if I stop holding back entirely?"
The moment that thought surfaced within his mind—
Boom!!!
A horrifying shockwave erupted violently from Max’s body.

The surrounding ground collapsed instantly beneath the pressure as countless cracks spread across the clearing like massive spiderwebs tearing through the earth. Violent winds exploded outward in every direction while the nearby participants felt their expressions change drastically as the pressure radiating from Max suddenly multiplied at an astonishing rate.
Several disciples instinctively staggered backward in horror.
"What... what is this?!" one participant shouted while trembling uncontrollably.
"He was still holding back before?!" another disciple exclaimed with disbelief written all over his face.
The black saber disciple’s face turned pale instantly as cold fear surged through his heart.
"No... this is impossible..." he muttered in shock.
Max slowly raised his head.
At that moment, the pressure radiating from him no longer resembled the aura of a normal cultivator at all.
It felt like a humanoid beast standing before them.
A monster wearing human skin.
Then suddenly—
Max disappeared once more.
Boom!!!
The place where he had been standing exploded apart violently from the sheer force of his movement.
The next instant, he appeared directly before a disciple wielding a long spear.
The young man’s pupils contracted violently as terror exploded within his mind.
"Wait—!"
Before he could even finish speaking, Max’s fist had already descended toward him.
There was no martial technique.
No concept.
No law.
Only absolute physical power.
Boom!!!
The disciple’s body exploded instantly upon contact.
There was no blood spraying through the air.
No flesh remaining behind.
The instant Max’s fist struck him, the participant’s entire body shattered directly into countless golden particles that scattered through the air like dust illuminated by sunlight.
He had been eliminated from the Survival Trial instantly.
At the same moment, a system notification appeared before Max’s eyes.
[+350 Killing Points]
Max did not even pause after seeing the notification.
Boom!
Another participant exploded apart into golden particles.
Boom!
A hammer-wielding genius disappeared instantly after Max’s punch shattered his body completely.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Everywhere Max moved, participants vanished one after another as though they were incapable of resisting him even slightly.
No one could stop him.
No one could even defend against a single attack.
The most horrifying part of all was that Max still had not used any laws, concepts, sword arts, or lightning techniques throughout the massacre.
He was relying purely on the monstrous physical strength granted by the Vein of Strength alone.
And that strength by itself was already enough to completely overwhelm peak Law Refinement Realm geniuses without giving them the slightest opportunity to resist.
Panic instantly spread throughout the clearing.
"This monster!"
"He’s killing people with his bare hands!"
"How can someone this strong exist at the Law Awakening Realm?!"
The woman wielding twin daggers suddenly turned around and desperately attempted to flee as fear completely overwhelmed her courage.
However, before she could even escape more than a few meters—
Boom!!!
Max appeared directly behind her like a phantom.
She barely had enough time to widen her eyes in terror before his fist descended mercilessly.
Her body shattered into countless golden particles instantly.
[+420 Killing Points]
The notifications before Max’s eyes began increasing rapidly one after another.
[+380 Killing Points]
[+410 Killing Points]
[+360 Killing Points]
[+450 Killing Points]
One participant after another was completely eliminated from the trial.
The clearing gradually fell silent.

Only countless golden particles drifted slowly through the air like glowing dust while the shattered ground, destroyed trees, and massive craters stood as silent proof of the massacre that had just taken place.
Moments later—
The final remaining disciple staggered backward while staring at Max with absolute terror written across his face.
The greed and confidence he possessed earlier had long vanished completely.
Only fear remained.
"You... you monster..." he muttered while trembling uncontrollably.
Max calmly walked toward him step by step.
Every footstep caused the ground beneath his feet to crack faintly from the overwhelming force within his body.
The disciple’s face turned deathly pale as he desperately attempted to retreat further.
However—
Boom!!!
Max’s fist struck forward once again.
The final participant exploded into countless golden particles instantly.
Silence completely returned to the clearing.
Max slowly lowered his fist while the seven-colored lightning surrounding his body flickered faintly around him.
Then the system notifications continuously appeared before his eyes one after another.
[+350 Killing Points]
[+420 Killing Points]
[+390 Killing Points]
[+410 Killing Points]
His Killing Points skyrocketed at an astonishing speed.
Soon afterward, the ranking screen before him updated rapidly.
[Name: Max Morgan]
[Killing Points: 6,820]
[Rank: 3]
Max calmly looked at the screen for several moments before a faint smile slowly appeared on his face.
"So this is how the Survival Trial works..." he murmured softly.
Then his gaze slowly shifted deeper toward the endless forest stretching far ahead of him.
The anticipation within his eyes gradually sharpened.
"If that’s the case..."
A faint crackle of seven-colored lightning echoed around him once more.
"Then this trial is perfect for farming Killing Points."

chapters.title: Chapter 1648: Arriving before a tower!
paragraphs: Having personally experienced the true power of the Third Divine Vein, Max could not help but feel deeply satisfied.

As the violent energy of the Vein of Strength gradually settled within his body, he slowly flexed his fingers while feeling the terrifying physical force still coursing through his muscles and bones. Even now, every movement carried an explosive sense of power, as though his body had transformed into a weapon capable of crushing mountains barehanded.
What truly surprised Max was the sheer amplification the Vein of Strength provided.
The increase was far beyond what he had initially expected.

Before opening the Third Divine Vein, Max already possessed frightening physical strength due to his Black Dragon Chaotic Bloodline, his Dragon Scales Transformation, and the terrifying boost granted by his five thousand Draconic Essences.
Yet now—
The Vein of Strength had elevated that raw power to an entirely different level.
"If I combine the Vein of Strength with all five thousand Draconic Essences and activate Dragon Scales Transformation at the same time..." Max thought quietly to himself.
A faint glint appeared within his eyes.
"Then just how terrifying would my physical strength become?"
Even Max himself found it difficult to estimate the answer.
The thought alone was enough to make his blood stir slightly.
However, he quickly pushed the idea aside.
There was no point thinking too deeply about it now. The Survival Trial had only just begun, and there would be plenty of opportunities later to fully test the limits of his strength.
Soon, Max’s gaze shifted toward the ranking screen floating before him once again.
[Name: Max Morgan]
[Killing Points: 6,820]
[Rank: 3]
Max raised an eyebrow slightly.
Even after eliminating so many participants and obtaining such a massive number of killing points in one go, he was still only ranked third.
This immediately sparked his curiosity.
"Who exactly is above me?" he muttered softly.
Almost as though the system had heard his thoughts, another translucent screen suddenly appeared before his eyes.
It displayed the current rankings in detail.
[Rank 1: Jonathan Myres — 15,672 KP]
[Rank 2: Ray Willer — 10,357 KP]
[Rank 3: Max Morgan — 6,820 KP]
[Rank 4: Julie — 5,632 KP]
"Hm," Max murmured quietly as he looked at the list. "So it’s Jonathan and Ray."
The results themselves were not particularly surprising.

Jonathan Myres was the strongest true disciple of the Violet Star Palace and one of the most powerful participants in the entire Smelting Trial. As for Ray Willer, Max had already expected him to climb the rankings quickly considering both his strength and personality.
However, Ray’s name reminded Max of something else entirely.
"That reminds me..." Max thought calmly. "Ray specifically said he intended to hunt me down."
His eyes narrowed slightly.
"But how exactly is he planning to kill me?"

Within the Soul Sealing Painting, death was not real death. The moment a participant was defeated, their soul would simply be expelled from the painting and returned safely to their physical body outside.
In other words, being killed here only meant elimination from the trial.
Nothing more.
"So where does his confidence come from?" Max wondered briefly.
Ray’s earlier words clearly carried genuine killing intent.
It did not sound like mere provocation.

For a moment, Max considered the possibility that Ray possessed some unknown method capable of affecting souls directly within the Soul Sealing Painting. However, after thinking about it for a while, he ultimately stopped dwelling on the matter.
No matter what schemes Ray possessed, Max had absolute confidence in his own strength.
If Ray truly came looking for him—
Then Max would simply crush him directly.
With that thought, Max calmly continued moving deeper into the forest.

Seven colored lightning flickered faintly around his body as his figure traveled rapidly through the massive world inside the Soul Sealing Painting. Along the way, he occasionally encountered scattered monsters or small groups of participants, but none of them were worth slowing down for.
Some participants fled the moment they sensed his aura.
Others tried attacking him greedily after noticing his ranking.
Every single one of them ended the same way.
Eliminated instantly.
As time passed, Max gradually moved farther and farther from the region where he initially entered the trial.
Then suddenly—
His eyes narrowed slightly.
In the far distance, beyond the endless sea of ancient trees, he spotted something enormous rising into the sky.
It was a tower.
A massive black tower stood towering over the forest like an ancient giant. Its height was so absurd that even from an enormous distance away, it remained clearly visible above the treetops.
The tower radiated a strange oppressive aura that immediately caught Max’s attention.
"Hm?"
Curiosity appeared in Max’s eyes almost instantly.
"What is that?"
Without hesitation, he changed direction and began moving toward the tower.
The closer he got, the clearer the structure became.
The tower looked ancient and weathered, as though it had existed for countless years. Dark stone covered its entire body while strange glowing symbols occasionally flickered across its surface.
However, what truly surprised Max was not the tower itself.
It was the chaos surrounding it.
Even before fully arriving, Max could already hear the sounds of explosions, weapon clashes, and furious shouting echoing throughout the area.
Boom!
A violent shockwave erupted near the lower levels of the tower while countless figures fought fiercely around it.
When Max finally arrived close enough to properly see the scene, even he became slightly surprised.
Hundreds of participants had gathered around the tower.
The surrounding area had turned into complete chaos.

Disciples from various forces were fighting everywhere while blood stained the stone ground surrounding the tower. Techniques continuously exploded through the air while screams and angry roars echoed endlessly.
Some participants fought desperately against one another while others climbed rapidly upward along the outer structure of the tower itself.
Only then did Max notice something unusual.
The tower was filled with caves.

Countless cave openings existed across the outer walls of the massive structure, stretching from the lower sections all the way toward the heavens. Some caves glowed faintly while others radiated dense spiritual fluctuations.
And the participants...
Were fighting madly for them.
"Get lost!"
"This cave belongs to me!"
"You think a trash disciple like you deserves a cultivation cave on the upper levels?!"
Boom!
A young man was blasted directly off the tower after losing a battle, his body crashing violently into the ground below.
Elsewhere, several participants worked together to force another group away from one of the higher cave entrances.
The higher the cave—
The fiercer the fighting became.
Max quietly observed the chaotic battlefield before him while his eyes slowly narrowed.
Clearly—
Those caves were extremely important.

This immediately sparked his curiosity.
"Who exactly is above me?" he muttered softly.
Almost as though the system had heard his thoughts, another translucent screen suddenly appeared before his eyes.
It displayed the current rankings in detail.
[Rank 1: Jonathan Myres — 15,672 KP]
[Rank 2: Ray Willer — 10,357 KP]
[Rank 3: Max Morgan — 6,820 KP]
[Rank 4: Julie — 5,632 KP]
"Hm," Max murmured quietly as he looked at the list.
"So it’s Jonathan and Ray."
The results themselves were not particularly surprising.
Jonathan Myres was the strongest true disciple of the Violet Star Palace and one of the most powerful participants in the entire Smelting Trial.
As for Ray Willer, Max had already expected him to climb the rankings quickly considering both his strength and personality.
However, Ray’s name reminded Max of something else entirely.
"That reminds me..." Max thought calmly.
"Ray specifically said he intended to hunt me down."
His eyes narrowed slightly.
"But how exactly is he planning to kill me?"
Within the Soul Sealing Painting, death was not real death.
The moment a participant was defeated, their soul would simply be expelled from the painting and returned safely to their physical body outside.
In other words, being killed here only meant elimination from the trial.
Nothing more.
"So where does his confidence come from?" Max wondered briefly.
Ray’s earlier words clearly carried genuine killing intent.
It did not sound like mere provocation.
For a moment, Max considered the possibility that Ray possessed some unknown method capable of affecting souls directly within the Soul Sealing Painting.
However, after thinking about it for a while, he ultimately stopped dwelling on the matter.
No matter what schemes Ray possessed, Max had absolute confidence in his own strength.
If Ray truly came looking for him—
Then Max would simply crush him directly.
With that thought, Max calmly continued moving deeper into the forest.
Seven colored lightning flickered faintly around his body as his figure traveled rapidly through the massive world inside the Soul Sealing Painting.
Along the way, he occasionally encountered scattered monsters or small groups of participants, but none of them were worth slowing down for.
Some participants fled the moment they sensed his aura.
Others tried attacking him greedily after noticing his ranking.
Every single one of them ended the same way.
Eliminated instantly.
As time passed, Max gradually moved farther and farther from the region where he initially entered the trial.
Then suddenly—
His eyes narrowed slightly.
In the far distance, beyond the endless sea of ancient trees, he spotted something enormous rising into the sky.
It was a tower.
A massive black tower stood towering over the forest like an ancient giant.
Its height was so absurd that even from an enormous distance away, it remained clearly visible above the treetops.
The tower radiated a strange oppressive aura that immediately caught Max’s attention.
"Hm?"
Curiosity appeared in Max’s eyes almost instantly.
"What is that?"
Without hesitation, he changed direction and began moving toward the tower.
The closer he got, the clearer the structure became.
The tower looked ancient and weathered, as though it had existed for countless years.
Dark stone covered its entire body while strange glowing symbols occasionally flickered across its surface.
However, what truly surprised Max was not the tower itself.
It was the chaos surrounding it.
Even before fully arriving, Max could already hear the sounds of explosions, weapon clashes, and furious shouting echoing throughout the area.
Boom!
A violent shockwave erupted near the lower levels of the tower while countless figures fought fiercely around it.
When Max finally arrived close enough to properly see the scene, even he became slightly surprised.
Hundreds of participants had gathered around the tower.
The surrounding area had turned into complete chaos.
Disciples from various forces were fighting everywhere while blood stained the stone ground surrounding the tower.
Techniques continuously exploded through the air while screams and angry roars echoed endlessly.
Some participants fought desperately against one another while others climbed rapidly upward along the outer structure of the tower itself.
Only then did Max notice something unusual.
The tower was filled with caves.
Countless cave openings existed across the outer walls of the massive structure, stretching from the lower sections all the way toward the heavens.
Some caves glowed faintly while others radiated dense spiritual fluctuations.
And the participants...
Were fighting madly for them.
"Get lost!"
"This cave belongs to me!"
"You think a trash disciple like you deserves a cultivation cave on the upper levels?!"
Boom!
A young man was blasted directly off the tower after losing a battle, his body crashing violently into the ground below.
Elsewhere, several participants worked together to force another group away from one of the higher cave entrances.
The higher the cave—
The fiercer the fighting became.
Max quietly observed the chaotic battlefield before him while his eyes slowly narrowed.
Clearly—
Those caves were extremely important.

chapters.title: Chapter 1649: A Tower of Treasures!
paragraphs: "What exactly is this tower for?" Max muttered quietly to himself as his eyes remained fixed on the enormous structure towering above the forest.
He truly had not expected something like this to exist within the Soul Sealing Painting.

At first, Max assumed the Survival Trial would simply be a brutal battlefield where participants hunted monsters, slaughtered one another, and accumulated killing points until only fifty people remained.
However, the appearance of this tower immediately made him realize that he had underestimated the complexity of the final trial once again.
This was not merely a simple survival game.
The Celestial Forge Pavilion had clearly designed this trial with far more depth than he initially imagined.
Boom!
Another explosion echoed nearby as several disciples fought fiercely over one of the lower cave entrances.

Max calmly observed the chaotic scene for a moment before deciding not to waste time guessing. Instead, he descended toward the ground near the outer area of the battlefield where a wounded participant was resting against a broken stone pillar while trying to recover his breath.
The young man appeared exhausted, and blood stained parts of his robe. Clearly, he had just lost a battle for one of the caves.
Max walked toward him calmly.
The participant instinctively raised his head after sensing someone approach.
Then—
His expression froze instantly.
"Ma... Max Morgan?!"
Shock spread across his face almost immediately as he stared at Max in disbelief.
Clearly, Max’s reputation had already spread throughout the Survival Trial.
The participant quickly straightened his posture subconsciously despite his injuries.
Max ignored the reaction and calmly asked,
"What is this tower?"
The wounded disciple blinked for a moment as though he did not expect Max to ask something so basic.
Then suddenly, he let out a bitter laugh.
He shook his head helplessly.
"First Jonathan Myres arrived here..."
"Then Ray Willer came..."
"And now even you are here too."
His tone carried clear frustration.
"It seems all the monsters gathered in this trial are slowly gathering at this tower."
Max simply looked at him calmly without responding.
Seeing that Max genuinely wanted an answer, the participant quickly explained.
"This tower appeared not long after the trial began," he said while glancing upward toward the massive structure. "At first, nobody understood what it was either."
His expression gradually became more serious.
"But eventually, people discovered something."
He pointed toward the countless caves spread across the surface of the tower.
"The caves inside the tower contain treasures."
Max’s eyes narrowed slightly.
"Treasures?"
The participant nodded immediately.
"Yes. Different kinds of treasures."
"Cultivation resources, artifacts, inheritances, techniques, rare ores, and all kinds of valuable materials."
As he spoke, even his own eyes revealed traces of greed and unwillingness.
"The important thing is..." he continued slowly, "those treasures are not illusions."
Max’s gaze sharpened faintly.
The participant inhaled deeply before continuing.
"Once someone touches a treasure within a cave, the Soul Sealing Painting records it automatically."
He paused briefly before adding,
"And after the trial ends, the Celestial Forge Pavilion will reward that participant with the actual treasure in reality."
The moment those words fell, even Max became slightly surprised.
So the treasures inside this world were essentially rewards reserved for the participants.
No wonder the fighting around the tower had become so intense.
A place like this would naturally attract everyone.
The wounded disciple looked toward the tower once more before speaking again.
"However, not all caves are equal."
Max followed his gaze upward.
"The lower caves usually contain ordinary rewards," the participant explained. "But the higher you climb..."
His expression gradually became more solemn.
"The more valuable and powerful the treasures become."
Max’s eyes slowly traveled upward along the massive tower.
The higher sections were almost hidden among the clouds themselves, radiating a faint ancient pressure even from a distance.
Meanwhile, the battles near those upper caves were clearly far more intense than the fighting below.
Powerful fluctuations continuously erupted from those areas as geniuses fought desperately to secure positions there.
"The upper caves..." the wounded participant said quietly, "are where the true treasures are located."
He then looked back at Max with a complicated expression.
"With your strength, you’ll probably try climbing higher."
A bitter smile appeared on his face.
"People like us can only fight over the lower caves."
Max remained silent for a moment while observing the towering structure before him.
Now everything made sense.
The Survival Trial was not merely about slaughter and killing points.
The tower itself acted as another battlefield.
A place where opportunities, treasures, and competition all converged together.
And judging from the current situation—
The higher one climbed...
The more dangerous things would become.
After listening to the explanation, Max finally understood why the area around the tower had become such a battlefield.
Treasure caves.
Real rewards.
And the higher one climbed, the greater the rewards waiting above.
The Celestial Forge Pavilion truly had gone all out for this Survival Trial.

Max slowly shifted his gaze upward once more toward the enormous tower piercing into the sky. Countless caves covered its outer surface while violent battles erupted across every level. Some participants fought desperately to defend caves they had already claimed, while others attempted to climb higher in search of better treasures.
The scene resembled a battlefield of greed and ambition.
Max then looked back toward the wounded participant.
"Thanks for the explanation," he said calmly.
The young man hurriedly nodded.
"No problem..."
Although he tried to remain composed, traces of nervousness still lingered on his face while standing before someone like Max.
After all, the stories surrounding Max within the trial had already begun spreading rapidly.
Max did not say anything further.
The next moment—
Crack!
Seven colored lightning suddenly erupted around his body.
Violent arcs of crimson, gold, silver, blue, violet, black, and green lightning wrapped around him as his aura surged sharply.
Boom!
The ground beneath his feet shattered instantly.
Max’s figure transformed into a streak of seven colored light as he shot directly toward the massive tower at astonishing speed.
The wounded participant stared blankly at the scene.
"So fast..." he muttered unconsciously.
Meanwhile, Max rapidly closed the distance toward the upper sections of the tower.
Since the higher caves contained better rewards, there was naturally no reason for him to waste time competing for the lower ones.
The violent winds screamed around him while the seven colored lightning pushed his speed to terrifying levels.
However—

chapters.title: Chapter 1650: Climbing the Tower!
paragraphs: The moment Max neared the tower itself—
His expression suddenly changed slightly.
Boom!!!
An overwhelming pressure descended from above without warning.
The air around the tower instantly became unimaginably heavy.
Max felt as though an invisible mountain had suddenly crashed down onto his body.
The seven colored lightning surrounding him flickered violently as his forward momentum came to an abrupt halt.
"What?"
Max’s eyes narrowed instantly.
The pressure around the tower was terrifying.
It was not ordinary suppression.
The closer he approached the tower, the heavier the invisible force became, almost as though the entire structure itself rejected flight.
Boom!
Max attempted to push forward forcefully using his physical strength and lightning movement technique.
However, the pressure only intensified further.
The surrounding space distorted heavily while the force pressing down upon him multiplied explosively.
Even someone with Max’s monstrous body felt his movements slowing drastically.
Then suddenly—
Bang!
Max’s body was violently slammed against the outer wall of the tower.
Stone cracked beneath the impact as the enormous pressure forced him downward.
The seven colored lightning around him exploded chaotically while his body slid several meters across the dark stone surface before finally stopping.
Below, several participants witnessed the scene and immediately reacted.
"Hah! Another one got slammed down!"
"I told you flying is impossible near the tower!"
Even some participants fighting nearby briefly looked upward in shock after recognizing Max.
"That’s Max Morgan!"
"He got forced down too?"
Max ignored the voices around him while slowly stabilizing himself against the wall of the tower.
Then his eyes gradually sharpened with realization.
"So that’s how it works..."
He could now clearly feel the strange force enveloping the entire tower.
The closer one moved toward it, the stronger the suppression became.
It was specifically designed to prevent flight.
No matter how powerful a participant’s movement technique or flying ability was, they would eventually be forced down onto the tower itself.
In other words—
Everyone had to climb physically.
No shortcuts existed here.
Max slowly looked upward toward the countless caves spread across the tower.
Now he finally understood why all the participants were climbing manually instead of simply flying toward the upper caves.
The force surrounding the tower made aerial movement nearly impossible.
To claim the treasures hidden within the caves, one had to ascend step by step while enduring the pressure of the tower itself and fighting against countless other participants along the way.
The higher one climbed—
The stronger the pressure would likely become.
A faint smile slowly appeared on Max’s face.
"This tower..." he murmured quietly.
"It really was designed to force everyone into competition."
At that moment, another violent battle erupted not far above him as several participants fought fiercely for control over a middle level cave.
Shockwaves spread across the tower while disciples continuously climbed upward like ants struggling to ascend a mountain.
Max looked upward calmly.
Then—
Without hesitation—
He placed his hand against the tower wall and began climbing upward himself.
Max climbed steadily along the surface of the enormous tower while seven colored lightning flickered faintly around his body.
The pressure surrounding the tower truly was extraordinary.

The higher he climbed, the heavier the invisible force pressing down upon him became. It felt as though the entire tower was trying to drag every participant back downward, forcing them to rely solely on their own strength to ascend.
Along the way, Max passed countless caves scattered throughout the lower regions of the tower.

Some caves had already been occupied by participants who sat within them while absorbing treasures or recovering their strength. Other caves had become battlefields where disciples fought desperately to drive one another away.
The tower was in complete chaos.

Explosions echoed continuously while spiritual energy fluctuations erupted from every direction. Participants occasionally lost battles and fell screaming from higher layers of the tower before crashing far below.
However, Max did not stop moving.
The treasures in the lower regions failed to interest him.
He continued climbing upward calmly while enduring the increasingly terrifying pressure surrounding the tower.
Eventually—
He reached the Fifth Layer.
The moment Max pulled himself onto the platform connected to the fifth layer, his eyes narrowed slightly as he observed the scene before him.
Unlike the lower levels, the number of participants here had decreased drastically.

The pressure in this region was already intense enough that weaker disciples could not even remain standing comfortably for long periods of time. Every movement required far more effort than before, and even circulating spiritual energy felt noticeably slower.
Clearly, reaching this level was already difficult for ordinary participants.

In front of Max stood a massive cave entrance embedded directly into the black stone wall of the tower. Ancient runes faintly glowed around the cave while waves of dense spiritual fluctuations seeped outward from within.
Even without entering, it was obvious that the treasure inside this cave was far superior to anything located in the lower layers.
However, the cave was currently occupied.
Or rather—
Contested.
Several participants were fiercely battling on the wide stone platform located directly outside the cave entrance.
Boom!

A violent shockwave erupted as two disciples clashed head on, causing cracks to spread across the platform beneath them. Nearby, another participant attempted to sneak toward the cave entrance itself only to be forced back by sword energy from another group.
The fighting was intense.
No one was willing to back down.
After all, everyone understood how valuable the treasures within the fifth layer caves likely were.
At that exact moment—
Max stepped fully onto the platform.
Crack.
The faint sound of his footsteps echoed lightly across the battlefield.
It was not loud.
Yet strangely—
Almost everyone present instinctively noticed him immediately.
The chaotic battle slowed slightly as one participant after another turned toward the newly arrived figure.
Then their expressions changed.
"That’s..."
"Max Morgan?!"
"The number one genius from the previous trials?"
Shock spread across the platform almost instantly.
Even the disciples currently fighting stopped momentarily as their attention shifted completely toward Max.
The seven colored lightning flickering faintly around his body made him extremely recognizable, especially after the earlier rumors that had already spread throughout the Survival Trial.
A spear wielding disciple’s expression became serious immediately.
"What is he doing here already?"
Another participant frowned deeply.
"To reach the fifth layer this quickly..."
"He really is monstrous."
A young man standing closest to the cave entrance narrowed his eyes sharply while gripping his sword tighter.
The atmosphere on the platform immediately became tense.

Unlike the lower participants earlier who underestimated Max because of his cultivation, the geniuses capable of reaching the fifth layer were far more cautious. They clearly understood that someone capable of ranking among the top participants in two consecutive trials could never be simple.
Moreover they had also seen Max ranked 3rd in this trial too and because of that they were even more cautious.
Even if Max’s cultivation appeared lower—
No one here dared to truly underestimate him carelessly.
Max himself calmly looked around the platform while ignoring the various gazes directed toward him.
His eyes briefly landed on the cave entrance before slowly scanning the surrounding participants.
There were around ten people here.
And every single one of them was strong.
Far stronger than the participants he previously eliminated below.
At that moment, one of the disciples suddenly spoke while staring directly at Max.
"You came for this cave too?"
The platform instantly fell silent.
Every gaze remained fixed on Max, waiting for his answer.
